title: Download Service State
description: Saves whatever reaches it as a file, through the browser's own download, and passes it on. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/download)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

filename.description: What the file is offered as

mimeType.description: The file's type; empty decides it from the input, as above
